title: a particle engine killer
description: Kills particles at the source unlike other mods for no lag. Vulkan and Sodium compatible
body:
Kills the particle "engine" at the source. Unlike other particle mods that cull or hide particles, this cancels them before any object is allocated - nothing is created, ticked or rendered. Zero overhead for performance instances. As far as I know, I am the only person whos done this. This is compatible with both VulkanMod and Sodium

I actually encourage people to fork this and make it available for other versions while keeping it lightweight. Give credit where its due. Since theres no config, (or any plans to add one) I wouldn't reccomend this for games like MCCI sky battle or pvp gamemodes with potion effects

As far as I know, only block-break particles are seen in the newest versions, but everything else works. Originally made for 1.21.4 but the other listed versions should work aswell
